'''''Star Wars: Battle for Hoth''''' is a tower-defense [[Star Wars video games|mobile game]] developed by [http://www.fluffylogic.net FluffyLogic] and published by [[THQ]] Wireless for the [[Wikipedia:Apple Inc.|Apple]] [[Wikipedia:iOS|iPhone]] and [[Wikipedia:iPod Touch|iPod Touch]]. It was released on [[July 7]], [[2010]]. It was available on the [[Wikipedia:App Store|Apple App Store]] for $2.99 [[Wikipedia:USD|USD]].
